newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norway's Scana to buy Chinese steel works.
newsitem.headline: Norway's Scana to buy Chinese steel works.

text.p: Norwegian industrial group Scana Industrier ASA said on Friday it was in negotiations to but a steel works in China.

Scana will be the largest shareholder in the plant with 60 percent. The World Bank will take 10 percent, with the rest taken up by local investors, the company said at a presentation in the Norwegian capital Oslo.
Scana's investment will amount to 180 million crowns.
"We will be buying the steel works and will upgrade it over a three-year period," Scana head Rolf Ahlqvist told reporters.
Ahlqvist said the deal was yet to be signed but negotiations had gone far.
